Each scenario builds a fresh Buildings + Construction pair over the single shared EntityDirectory, drives only documented public APIs (place_building, open_build/open_upgrade/open_furniture/open_demolition, deliver_material, begin_work, add_work_mwu, commit_completion, begin_refund/close_refund, designate_room, place_furniture), guards every fixture and mutator result before using its output so a failed setup returns early rather than masquerading as a pass, and reads genuine unmodified Construction.state_bytes() through the reviewed probe framing method: an independently declared serialization-order table, per-segment lengths measured at runtime from var_to_bytes of an exact-type/extent zeroed prototype (no hardcoded Variant header or offset), a whole-buffer total-length check before any slice, and decoded type/count checks before any index. Every retirement asserts the exact sixteen retained scalars, all four delivered ledger cells, store live_count, the returned typed row and null reference, project reference staleness/generation death, and the subject's lifetime: furniture, its room and host hall survive all three furniture outcomes; demolition cancellation restores ACTIVE and retains DEMOLITION policy; the demolition return manifest is read at WORK_DONE before completion retires the handle; cancellation manifests use exact independent source literals (4000/3200; 20000-40000-8000 and 16000-32000-6400; 2000-1000 and 1600-800) and demolition cancellation asserts REFUSE_IS_A_DEMOLITION. Retired purpose, type_id, max_workers, phase and refund policy are asserted as retained (never recomputed from the cleared work_begun). Each completed scenario prints one compact JSON record of the actually observed sixteen fields, ledger, live_count, purpose/outcome and subject result, explicitly scoped to public component lifecycle only, not gameplay, inventory conservation or save acceptance. An optional per-case Columns check admits only the one observed row into an otherwise-clear image and is labelled row-admission only, claiming no whole-snapshot projection and no same-type-swap oracle. No private field access, no _retire call, no exception suppression, no production source change. The focus runner is extended to list the new suite fourth, preserving the const Array[String] declaration with a runtime PackedStringArray return. Nothing was executed, run or applied; this is authored source only, offered for independent review.

extends "res://test/run_tests.gd"
## Focused runner for the CONSTRUCTION-S4-VALIDATE-R01v2 tranche.
##
## Reuses run_tests.gd's whole supervisor/worker/marker-audit machinery unchanged, overriding
## only suite discovery so exactly the new suites plus the existing test_construction.gd run,
## not the whole test directory. The fourth entry is the twelve real public retirement histories,
## which is component-lifecycle evidence only and certifies no saved identity or gameplay claim.
## Usage, from the repository root:
##     godot --headless --path godot --script test/construction_columns_focus.gd

const FOCUS_SUITES: Array[String] = [
	"res://test/test_construction.gd",
	"res://test/test_construction_columns.gd",
	"res://test/test_save_owner_construction.gd",
	"res://test/test_construction_retired_histories.gd",
]


func _discover_suites() -> PackedStringArray:
	"""Exactly the four suites this focused tranche must run, in this fixed order."""
	return PackedStringArray(FOCUS_SUITES)
